content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fresno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or equivalent, you already meet the foundational requirement. Verify your education credentials and review the contact-hour requirement before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp format. Attend focused sessions that compress core project management knowledge into an intensive schedule, designed for working professionals in Fresno's agriculture, healthcare, construction, and public sectors who need flexible learning.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once your education is complete, register with PMI and submit your CAPM application. You'll provide proof of your secondary degree and contact hours, then pay the PMI exam fee. Granite PM Academy can guide you through each submission requirement.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Take the proctored CAPM exam, available in multiple formats and test windows. Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources and practice materials to build your confidence and help you demonstrate mastery of project management fundamentals.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning CAPM, commit to a three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Continue your learning through training, volunteer work, and industry participation to keep your credential active and stay current with project management practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
